structure.layout: single-column dark landing page with floating pill nav, centered functional hero tool, then stacked 1024px-wide sections each with eyebrow + split heading/intro, ending in FAQ and multi-column footer

aesthetics.typography: Geist for headings, body and nav (800 for the 128px wordmark, 600 for section H2s, 500 for H3/FAQ questions); Geist Mono for uppercase letter-spaced eyebrows, status labels, step numbers, CLI commands and terminal mock
aesthetics.typeScale: Extreme contrast: 128px/800 hero wordmark, 36px/600 section headings, 18px tagline, 14-16px body, 10-13px mono uppercase tracked labels

notes: Near-black monochrome design with white as the only 'primary' (white pill buttons with black text) and a tiny green status dot as the sole saturated accent; pale-blue mono eyebrows label each section. Every section repeats the same grammar: mono uppercase eyebrow, 2-line 36px heading on the left, muted intro paragraph on the right column, then content. Hairline dividers separate sections. The hero is the actual working product (send panel with dashed dropzone, live latency '9MS' and 'READY'). The nav is a floating rounded pill that stays sticky and highlights the current section (scroll-spy). CLI section pairs OS install tabs with a realistic ASCII terminal transcript; desktop section uses a miniature app screenshot. Capability grid uses shared 1px cell borders instead of separate cards. Copy is honest/plainspoken ('No asterisks.', 'The fine print, printed large.').
